summary: The evidence supports the close candidate on every predicate. The plan text before §12 hashes to the approved r2 digest 76ddbb2b, so the amendments keep the approved criteria. The D1 narrowing follows the owner's D1b ruling in the SI1 spec. The shard sums in both lane receipts match the stated totals: 22,146 and 22,149. release-tag.txt shows the annotated tag 9d1021d8 peeling to merge 9c051d52. That merge's second parent is the tested head c89e55e6, and the merge differs from it only by the two PR #312 planning documents. The Rmap timing test is unmarked and falls in shard 3 under the runner's file-index%6 assignment. Nothing blocks the close. The three remaining hardening concerns are: RC-02 has no named residual target, the corrected lane quietly changes the uv toolchain, and the predicate-6 digest and review-helper claims have no recorded receipt. A fourth point, that a single passing run disposes the intermittent timing question, is folded into the RC-02 concern.
